summary: Derive the judge's failingFiles from the run's failures; drop RunResult.failingFiles

per.section: Derived state is computed, never restated beside its source

acceptance: RunResult carries no failingFiles; JudgeVerdict.failingFiles is computed from the failures the run reported, and the named-lines gate blames the same files it does today.
tests: the judge names its failing files from the failures the run reported
notes: harness/runner.ts:84 asks every consumer's runner for a list harness/vitestRunner.ts:198 dedups straight off `failures`; harness/judge.ts:164 copies it onto the verdict and harness/chain.ts:425 onto GateResult.failingFiles, which src/priorAttempts.ts:153 keys suspectFlake on. A runner whose copy drifts from its failures silently changes the prior-attempt record. One judge-side derivation cannot disagree with its source.
